headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to review their advisory committees and judge whether they are still useful.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on federal advisory committees, the outside expert and citizen panels that give advice to government agencies. Based on its title, it directs agencies to evaluate how useful these committees are and to make changes to improve them. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, such as which committees might be ended or changed, are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to review the advisory committees they run and judge their value.
People who serve on these panels could see their committees reviewed, changed, or possibly ended.

who_it_affects.group: Groups and members of the public who give input through advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: Changes to committees could affect the ways outside groups share advice with the government.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 14, 2019; specific deadlines are not stated in the material provided.
